job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled ML Research Engineer with expertise in pre-training of LLMs to join our team at Eka.care. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in machine learning and natural language processing.



Roles and Responsibility




Design and develop scalable data pipelines for large-scale text datasets.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into existing systems.


Conduct research on new ML algorithms and techniques to improve model performance.


Develop and maintain large-scale data architectures to support model training.


Work closely with data engineers to ensure seamless data ingestion and processing.


Evaluate and optimize the performance of ML models using various metrics and techniques.




Job Requirements




Strong understanding of deep learning concepts, including transformer models and BERT.


Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.


Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS or Google Cloud for deploying ML models.


Knowledge of agile development methodologies and version control systems like Git.


Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.


Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse stakeholders.




Disclaimer: This job description has been sourced from a public domain and may have been modified by Naukri.com to improve clarity for our users. We encourage job seekers to verify all details directly with the employer via their official channels before applying.
